name: zeffect_handle_camera_params_event
description: zEffect::HandleCameraParamsEvent applies flagged camera near/far, clip distance, FOV, and viewport updates to a target node reference.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this event handler; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect event-handler/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x459580 validates the null/self/runtime/event and negative target-node guards, flag-gated preservation of the opposite near/far/FOV/viewport field through the corresponding getter, SetClipDistance dispatch, and return value 2.

The native smoke verifies all seven flag paths update camera near/far clip, clip distance, frustum dimensions, viewport dimensions, derived FOV values, and dirty flags, and verifies the null and negative target guards return 2 without changing camera state.
